world.geography: New Zealand (a fictional district, its council water supply and the regional public health service; personas on the en_NZ index)
world.org_type: regional public health service advising a district council water supplier

driver: The unit an event belongs to is set by a configuration that changes through raw switch operations on a network, so the published register of which source serves which area misattributes the events; the true source is the one whose output reached each event's area during that event's own exposure window, rebuilt by tracing the network through the switch log day by day.
driver_concrete: Each case zone's water during the case's incubation window came from whichever source the valve operations connected it to, so the supply-zone register points the outbreak at reservoir R4, which normally feeds the two worst zones, while the water that made people ill came through boundary main BM3 from another reservoir's network on the three wet days the zones were back-fed during a feed-main repair.
stump: A competent solver computes attack rates by supply zone, maps them through the supply-zone register and names reservoir R4 as the asset to take out of service, never tracing the worst zones' supply through the valve operations over each case's incubation window, which puts their exposure on boundary main BM3.
